text: Ladies and gentlemen, welcome to the weigh-in! This one is my own entry, so yes, I am hyping myself, and no, I do not get to score it. Realism is judged by the owner, not me. She passed every automated check. This round was pure face work: skin shaded dark under the hair cap, feathered at the hairline, so bare skin no longer peeks through. No new moves, but what a hairline! At one point seven three meters, the patient counter-striker in terracotta, the Hairline Hustler, CLAUDE!
